text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I only hope there is someone worth 
slaughtering.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Every single prediction I've made today 
has been totally wrong! Urrgh! Why won't 
my wishes reach them?!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, good work, good work~ Well, if 
it's the main event, your wish is bound to 
reach them.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
For the Osaka Hai, it's gotta be Orfevre! 
That's a no-brainer.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Sure, she lost to Gentildonna, but still. 
That girl is just at a different pinnacle 
of her own.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre is still the "King"! —She 
definitely won't lose to any other 
Umamusume!

The day of the Osaka Hai—Verxina enters 
her first true showdown with Orfevre, the 
strongest Classic Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! Ah—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Does it merely sway in the wind?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a frail and unreliable flower.

With the race right before us, the King's 
majesty was enough to make even an adult 
like me flinch. Verxina seemed a bit 
overwhelmed as well—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Pathetic.

"She's only just managed to get back on 
her feet. We want to avoid a severe 
relapse... If so, all I have to do is 
reinforce the confidence she's gained!"
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, remember what your weapons 
are.

text_block_list.text:
What Verxina showed in her Classic Year. 
That is her greatest weapon— the fighting 
spirit to battle for someone else's sake.

"Acknowledging that, she answered, 
'Therefore, I am invincible.' 'That will 
never fade.'"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, if only I could burn 
fiercely... just like back then...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I might have been able to respond in kind 
to that fighting spirit."
choice_data_list: Then let's stoke the fire again!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Family
text_block_list.text:
Verxina!! Do your best~!! Verxina-chan! 
Big sis! Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: "Everyone! Let's spread it out—ready, go!"

What her family brought was a cheering 
banner for Verxina. Written upon it was...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
""Our 'Number One'! Verxina reaches the 
summit"—"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong anyone is, it'll be 
fine! You're definitely number one, 
Verxina-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Just being who you are... makes you 
special and the strongest to us!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
I love you, Verxina-chan!! Go out there 
and run your heart out~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Papa... Mama...
choice_data_list: (Her family's love lights a fire in her)

text_block_list.text:
Fighting spirit is a weapon honed and 
strengthened by deep love... and revived 
endlessly by the cheers of family.

As long as the bond of family endures— as 
long as life goes on... that cheer will 
never fade.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will never hesitate again. I won't be 
broken...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Because I am... your big sister!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That's why...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOO!! Orfeeeeeeevre!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...She's so popular after all. I wonder if 
Verxina-san is going to be okay—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You seem rather bored, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, shall I accompany you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...To stand before me. That means—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Is this an expression of your intent to 
become a sacrifice?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No! Certainly not... That could not be 
further from the truth.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I stand before you. And the only reason 
for that... is simply to bar your way.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Just like that one, is the Tiara a 
title for those who don't know their 
place?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Perhaps you were simply outshone by 
the brilliance of that tiara.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, wouldn't you say that I, 
too, possess the power to eclipse your 
light?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You have finally deigned to look at me, 
I see.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san, if I defeat you... I'll be one 
step closer to that person.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing the King, and going beyond— You 
shall serve as my stepping stone to the 
pinnacle!
